title: Data analyst sent to prison for stealing data, extorting employer
summary: A former data analyst contractor for Brightly Software has been sentenced to two years in prison for targeting his employer in a $2.5 million extortion scheme. Once attackers are using valid credentials, prevention drops sharply.
